opening.argument: The presentation offers a practical troubleshooting pathway for a specific Chrome DNS error: viewers are directed to change proxy settings, open the Connection and LAN settings, and enable automatic detection. Its title identifies the technical problem as DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN, while the instructions focus on browser and Windows network configuration. This is an operational tutorial rather than a financial offer or credential request, and the supplied material describes no deceptive mechanism for participation or payment.

citations.quote: Fix DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN|DNS address could not be found in Google chrome
Solution: Goto settings-show advanced settings-network-change proxy settings.
Click "connection" tab and then go to "LAN settings".
